name: Ramucirumab + paclitaxel (second-line metastatic adenocarcinoma)
cyclesNote: Ramucirumab plus weekly paclitaxel for metastatic gastric / esophagogastric adenocarcinoma progressing after a first-line platinum-fluoropyrimidine (RAINBOW population); continue until progression or unacceptable toxicity.

institution.provenance: StewardMD ONCOTREE draft protocol authored from standard guidelines (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

premedications.name: Paclitaxel hypersensitivity prophylaxis
premedications.notes: Corticosteroid plus H1 and H2 antihistamine before paclitaxel.

supportiveCare: Anti-VEGFR2 antibody plus taxane; monitor blood pressure, proteinuria, bleeding, and wound healing on ramucirumab.
Monitor for peripheral neuropathy and myelosuppression from paclitaxel.
monitoring: blood pressure before each ramucirumab dose
CBC before each weekly paclitaxel dose

doseModificationRules.text: Hold ramucirumab for uncontrolled hypertension or significant proteinuria; resume when controlled; physician decides.
Reduce or hold paclitaxel for significant sensory neuropathy; physician decides.

drugs.name: Ramucirumab
drugs.notes: Ramucirumab 8 mg/kg IV on days 1 and 15 of a 28-day cycle, combined with weekly paclitaxel, for second-line metastatic gastric / esophagogastric adenocarcinoma. Monitor blood pressure, proteinuria, and bleeding. StewardMD standard-of-care wording; physician decides and the dose engine computes the patient dose.

drugs.name: Paclitaxel
drugs.notes: Paclitaxel 80 mg/m2 IV on days 1, 8, and 15 of a 28-day cycle (paclitaxel is omitted on day 22 in the RAINBOW schedule). Give hypersensitivity premedication. StewardMD standard-of-care wording; physician decides and the dose engine computes the patient dose.
